contextReview.basis: Direct review: cloudy night harbour promenade with warm stucco walls, wall lamps and moored boats; no rain depicted (dry-looking paving); humidity not inferred.

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: Rear view: the navy jacket has long sleeves pushed up (not a vest), so its front and full sleeves are conservative reconstructions; the pale gray long-sleeve inner is a separate product. The cap is held in hand and the watch face is only partly visible. Hidden soles are inferred. Brand, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

producerVisualReview.findings: All28 viewed on4 backgrounds: no opaque rectangles, obvious halos or clipping. Shapes/colors match editorials.03 hydration vest has two chest buckles and no center zip, blue top owns upper-arm bands.05 jacket full sleeves reconstructed from pushed-up rear view; gray inner separate. Shoe pairs aligned overhead; socks paired; watch and cap complete. Hidden details conservative, no brand/verified-performance claim.

deck.ko: 네이비 두 겹 사이로 회색이 남기는 가벼운 여백.
deck.en: A little gray space between two navy layers.
deck.de: Etwas grauer Abstand zwischen zwei marineblauen Lagen.

intro.ko: 달리기를 마치고 캡을 벗으며 카메라 쪽으로 웃어 보입니다.
intro.en: Finishing the run, he lifts his cap and smiles back at the camera.
intro.de: Nach dem Lauf hebt er die Cap und lächelt zur Kamera zurück.

body.ko: 네이비 후드 재킷의 소매를 올려 회색 이너를 드러냈습니다. 뒤쪽 어깨의 반사선과 손목 시계는 다른 크기의 포인트가 됩니다. 타이츠와 캡은 같은 네이비로 연결하고 회색 양말과 러닝화로 발목을 정리했습니다. 뒤돌아선 자세에서도 전신의 선이 끊기지 않습니다.
body.en: Pushed-up navy jacket sleeves reveal the gray inner layer. Reflective back shoulder lines and a wristwatch add accents at different scales. Tights and cap repeat the navy, with gray socks and running shoes finishing the ankles. The full silhouette stays continuous through the turn.
body.de: Hochgeschobene Jackenärmel zeigen die graue Innenlage. Reflexlinien am Rücken und eine Armbanduhr setzen unterschiedlich große Akzente. Tights und Cap greifen Marineblau auf, graue Socken und Laufschuhe schließen ab. Die ganze Silhouette bleibt auch in der Drehung durchgehend.

pull.en: A line that lasts through the goodbye.
pull.de: Eine Linie bis zum letzten Gruß.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A line that lasts through the goodbye.

tip.ko: 회색 밑단과 커프를 조금 남겨 네이비 레이어를 구분하세요.
tip.en: Leave a little gray hem and cuff to separate the navy layers.
tip.de: Etwas grauen Saum und Bündchen zeigen, um Marineblau zu trennen.
